# Azure

Azure is a no-frills layout for long writing sessions, and in the editing modes it keeps heading text at the same size as body text. It offers light and dark modes and colours nesting indicators through six levels. It can also hide code comments in Live Preview for a plainer view.

![Azure screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/annagracedev/obsidian-azure/HEAD/azure_store.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Azure"
    author: "annagracedev"
    repo:   "annagracedev/obsidian-azure"
    slug:   "azure"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/azure"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/annagracedev/obsidian-azure"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/annagracedev/obsidian-azure/HEAD/azure_store.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Use a no-frills layout optimized for long writing sessions, keeping body and heading text the same size in editing modes. Switch between light and dark modes, view colored nesting indicators up to six levels, and hide code comments in Live Preview for a cleaner workspace."
}
```
